name: corpus_read
description: Read one document's markdown, by doc_id or path. Long documents are returned in windows: use offset with the returned next_offset to page to the end. total_chars and pct_of_document say how much of the document you have actually seen.

max_chars.description: characters to return in this window

offset.description: character offset to start from; pass the next_offset from the previous call to continue reading the same document
